style: Photoreal macro food film, 9:16 vertical. One warm luxury working kitchen, matte black griddle, dark charcoal counter, brushed steel spatula, warm amber side light, dark soft background. The same glossy brioche bun, two thin beef patties, cheddar, smoky chipotle mayo, pickled jalapeños and crisp onions form one physically plausible burger. Shallow depth of field, real grease sheen and steam, no plastic-looking cheese or impossible food motion.
requestedEnding: The same finished double smash burger is sliced, its halves pulled apart, and its crisp, juicy cross-section held in view.

storyArc.protagonist: one smoky jalapeño double smash burger
storyArc.setting: one dark charcoal counter with matte black griddle and warm amber side lighting
storyArc.goal: Build a tall, biteable double smash burger with crisp beef edges and a balanced smoky, tangy, crunchy finish.
storyArc.obstacle: The patties must brown quickly while the cheddar melts and the brioche toasts without drying out.
storyArc.turn: Smash thin patties hard for lacy edges, melt cheddar on both, then layer chipotle mayo, pickled jalapeños and crisp onions in a stable stack.
storyArc.visualBible: One burger, one pair of adult cook hands with short natural nails, no gloves, no face. Same matte black griddle, dark charcoal counter, brushed steel spatula, black small bowl of chipotle mayo, glass bowl of pickled jalapeños, ceramic bowl of crisp onions, warm amber light from camera left. Two beef patties only. Cheddar stays on the patties. Bottom bun, sauce, two patties, jalapeños, onions, top bun in that order. No extra food, duplicate burgers, text in generated imagery, logos, or set changes.

shots.imagePrompt: Extreme side macro of the finished single double smash burger filling the lower two-thirds of a 9:16 frame on a dark charcoal counter. The camera is so close that the lower bun and lower ingredients are cropped below frame. Show the glossy brioche top bun, the upper of two thin browned beef patties, and a thick vivid molten cheddar fold already draped over that patty's near edge, ready to move. One adult hand with short natural nails rests on the bun from above. Warm amber side light from camera left, matte black griddle blurred behind, dark clean upper frame for a separate text overlay. Realistic edible cheese texture, no raw white onion strips in view, no generated text.

The visible molten cheddar fold under the bun slowly bulges and drips over the near edge of the upper patty, then settles. Camera holds the tight side angle and makes only a small forward move; the lower half of the burger remains outside the frame. One continuous action, no cut, no extra hand or ingredient.

shots.narration: The finished burger is sliced cleanly in half.

shots.narration: Two halves pull apart to reveal the juicy cross-section.
shots.imagePrompt: Edit the prior image into a tight side macro of the exact same burger just sliced in half on the exact same black plate and dark counter. Two adult hands gently grip one half each at the cut. The newly exposed cross-sections clearly show two separate browned thin beef patties with a glossy melted yellow cheddar layer between them, a few green pickled jalapeño rings and golden crispy onion shreds above the meat, a restrained pale orange chipotle mayo seam, and the toasted brioche top and bottom. The halves are almost touching and ready to pull apart. Warm amber light from the same side; no pale raw onion strips and no missing cheese.
shots.motionPrompt: The hands pull the two freshly sliced burger halves apart by a few centimeters, revealing the complete crisp juicy cross-section. Hold steady on the exposed layers and let a small real bead of juice move; camera eases closer and stops. Same plate and kitchen, one continuous pull, no bite or new cut.
shots.sound: last crisp onion crunch, soft bun tear, quiet kitchen room tone

claimsToCheck: Creative food film; the recipe and imagery require human cooking and visual review before publication

recipe.status: creative kitchen formulation; cook and taste before publishing as a tested recipe
ingredients: 2 thin beef patties from freshly ground beef
method: Smash two beef balls thin on a hot griddle and cook thoroughly; add cheddar and let it melt.
Toast both brioche halves. Spread chipotle mayo on the bottom bun, stack the two cheddar patties, add pickled jalapeños and crispy onions, then close with the top bun.
Slice once, pull the halves apart, and serve immediately.
